before.text: You look like you're new. I'm Tess. I'd offer you a drink, but my stall's closed until Bram finds his storeroom key.

choices.text: Why does that close your stall?

gossip.text: This morning, somewhere in that yard of his. He won't ask for help, stubborn old goat. But if somebody offered...

stall.text: All my cider is in his storeroom. No key, no cider.

after.text: There's the hero of the hour! Bram's storeroom is open and my cider is flowing again.

drink.text: Here you go, first of the batch. Drink it whenever you like. You've got {item.gold} gold left, so don't let Mira talk you into buying a map.

news.text: Mira won't stop talking about you. And Bram's whistling. I've never heard Bram whistle.
